method: Historical parody and deliberate reinterpretation can establish a derivative without reused image pixels. Separate explicit documentary support from shared subject matter. No chronology, membership or artist changes.

accepted.evidence: Independent historical accounts explicitly identify the Nakamoto RAREPEPE card as a parody of SATOSHICARD and its collectibility. This is documentary evidence, not an assertion of identical imagery or a direct creator quotation.

held.reason: Both address Mt. Gox; GOXCARD predates GOXPEPE. No specific creator statement or sufficiently explicit historical account located in this pass. Different art alone is not a reason to reject.

additional_leads.evidence: CMYK explicitly describes his own NAKAMOTOCARD as a planned parody of SATOSHICARD. This statement must not be misquoted as Mike describing RAREPEPE. No primary registry member found in this snapshot; investigate admission separately.

policy: Preserve RAREPEPE as a source-review root even after adding its own antecedent; an influential derivative can itself have many derivatives.
